action.prompt:
Before completing the task, determine whether any persistent project knowledge changed during this session.

Persistent project knowledge includes:
- Features added, removed, or changed
- Bug fixes
- Architectural decisions
- Configuration changes
- Dependencies added or removed
- Environment variables
- Database or schema changes
- API changes (routes, methods, payloads)
- Build or deployment changes
- Folder structure changes
- Docker or infrastructure changes
- AI prompts or steering files that affect future behaviour
- Security or performance improvements
- CI/CD pipeline changes

If any of the above changed, read the existing PROJECT_LOG.md, then append a summary.

Do not append an entry if the same change has already been recorded.

Follow the project-log-standards steering file for format, style, and rules.
